source_caption_text:
A Ye fan proposed to his girlfriend during Runaway in Jakarta 🥹❤️💍

Via: @real_kj00 

Ye’s “Runaway” has been with us for 16 years 🎹🐐

Released in October 2010 featuring Pusha T, the song peaked at No. 12 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 13 weeks on the chart.

The album version runs for more than nine minutes on “My Beautiful Dark Twisted Fantasy.” Ye also released a 35-minute short film of the same name, expanding the album’s vision through music, choreography and cinematic storytelling.

Sixteen years later, that opening piano note still gets an entire crowd singing. 🔥

Where does “Runaway” rank in Ye’s catalog? 👀
